items.title: Inspect existing missing_scope_check and scope_check_save guidance surfaces
items.context: Identify the narrow canonical touchpoints for story_review blocker text, session guidance, and command help without changing gate semantics. Also record Authority readiness status and fail-closed behavior when Authority is not configured.
items.userSees: Inspection output identifies story-review.ts as the missing_scope_check source, confirms scope_check_save exists, and shows Authority mode is not configured so Authority completion is blocked.

happy.desc: Inspection identifies the exact existing story_review missing_scope_check message source and existing scope_check_save command/help surfaces.

edge.desc: Inspection distinguishes scope_check_save PLAN evidence from later scope_contract_check guards.

adversarial.desc: Inspection records Authority readiness as not configured and does not claim Authority completion from local CLI evidence.

items.title: Implement narrow missing_scope_check guidance improvements
items.context: Update only the surfaces needed to explain scope-check.json, scope_check_save, reviewer-written evidence, and Non-authority boundaries. Do not add auto-generation, self-signing, or Authority overclaim behavior.
items.userSees: When story_review reports missing_scope_check, the terminal explains that scope-check.json is missing, scope_check_save already exists, the scope-plan reviewer must persist evidence, and local guidance is not Authority completion.

happy.desc: story_review missing_scope_check guidance mentions missing scope-check.json, existing scope_check_save, and scope-plan reviewer-written evidence.

edge.desc: scope_check_save help clarifies reviewer-written PLAN gate evidence without changing command schema or allowed phase semantics.

adversarial.desc: Guidance does not instruct the main implementation agent to self-sign, manually edit story metadata, or claim Authority receipt verification/production completion.

items.title: Add targeted tests or smokes for the improved guidance
items.context: Cover the actionable message and negative cases for self-signing, gate weakening, and Authority overclaim. Prefer targeted message-path tests over broad lifecycle rewrites.
items.userSees: The targeted smoke fails if missing_scope_check guidance omits scope-check.json or scope_check_save, suggests self-signing, or implies Authority completion.

happy.desc: A targeted story-review ergonomics smoke covers the missing_scope_check message path.

edge.desc: The smoke protects the distinction between scope_check_save and scope_contract_check remediation.

adversarial.desc: The smoke contains negative assertions against self-signing language and Authority overclaim terms in the local guidance.

items.title: Run Authority-enforced review, validation, delivery, summary, and DONE closure
items.context: Complete local Lattice lifecycle only as Non-authority evidence unless a verified Authority gate_decision receipt is available. In Authority mode, DONE must fail closed without receipt-backed Authority proof.
items.userSees: Authority-mode dry-run reports receipt/readiness missing and keeps authorityDone=false/fullAuthorityDone=false; local REVIEW/TEST/DONE evidence is reported only as Non-authority unless verified gate_decision receipt proof exists.

happy.desc: Authority status and authority-mode dry-run evidence show fail-closed behavior without configured Authority readiness or receipt proof.

edge.desc: Local lifecycle validation remains usable as Non-authority evidence while Authority completion remains blocked without verified receipt.

adversarial.desc: DONE summary and delivery materials must not claim receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone unless receipt-backed proof is actually verified.
